memberdef.name: paintBanner

briefdescription.para: Paints the generated glyph banner into a TUI graphics context.

detaileddescription.para: Each banner row is colour-keyed by its own name and the prior row's name, used to blend the solid (█) and shaded (░) glyph colours between rows.

parameterdescription.para: The TUI graphics context to paint into.

briefdescription.para: Renders the generated banner offscreen and prints it to stdout.
Derives the CMake configure-dependency file list from a manifest (SPEC §4).

detaileddescription.para: The manifest itself, every ## outputs row's template and input tables, and every ## dispatch row's fragment template — never hand-maintained.

parameterdescription.para: The CAST.md manifest to derive dependencies from.

briefdescription.para: Runs cast::Driver::run() and reports the result on stdout/stderr.

detaileddescription.para: On success, prints the manifest's configure-dependency list (getConfigureDepends()) to stdout, one path per line, for CMake to consume.

parameterdescription.para: When non-empty, restricts regeneration to the named output row.

simplesect.para: 0 on success; 1 on failure, after printing the SPEC §8 failure to stderr.

briefdescription.para: cast CLI entry point: banner/help rendering and manifest dispatch.
